title: Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda Cancellation and Refund Terms
content:
# Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda — Cancellation and Refund Terms

This tariff of the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda sets, for each waiver, the free-look period, the refund method, the cancellation fee, and the switches that decide how an early payoff, a refinance or an unwound deal ends a waiver and to whom and how soon its refund is paid.

## Terms table

| Waiver | Free-look period after the sale date (calendar days) | Refund method after the free look | Cancellation fee (USD) | No fee on a termination for early payoff or refinance | Refund paid within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | 30 | pro rata daily | 50.00 | No | 30 |
| Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | 30 | pro rata daily | 50.00 | No | 30 |
| Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | 60 | pro rata daily | 50.00 | Yes | 30 |
| Kessler GAP Plus 150 | 60 | pro rata daily | 50.00 | Yes | 30 |
| Kessler GAP Plus 175 | 60 | pro rata daily | 50.00 | Yes | 30 |
| Kessler GAP Commercial 130 | 30 | pro rata daily | 75.00 | No | 30 |

## Switches common to every waiver

| Switch | Kessler GAP Waiver 125 | Kessler GAP Used Vehicle 140 | Kessler GAP Waiver 150 | Kessler GAP Plus 150 | Kessler GAP Plus 175 | Kessler GAP Commercial 130 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Refund computed automatically when the lienholder reports the loan paid off | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Refinancing with another lender ends the waiver | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Waiver on an unwound deal cancelled flat with a full refund | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Refund paid to the lienholder while the loan is open | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Glossary of the terms

- **Free-look period** — calendar days after the sale date within which a waiver is cancelled for a full refund.
- **Refund method** — how the refund after the free look is computed; pro rata daily means the unused days of the term over the total days of the term.
- **Cancellation fee** — the fee deducted from a refund after the free look.
- **No fee on a termination for early payoff or refinance** — where Yes, no fee is deducted when the waiver ends because the loan was paid off early or refinanced.
- **Refund paid within** — calendar days after the cancellation or termination is processed within which the refund is paid.
- The four switches read as their names say: whether the refund is computed automatically on a lienholder payoff report, whether a refinance ends the waiver, whether an unwound deal brings a flat full refund, and whether a refund goes to the lienholder while the loan is open.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Kessler GAP Waiver 150 sold on Day 0 is still inside its free look on Day 60 and outside it on Day 61; a Kessler GAP Waiver 125 sold the same day leaves its free look after Day 30.
